description: Fetch a Quora user's public profile metadata and one content section. Returns name, credential, bio, follower/following counts, answer/question/post counts, and the selected section: profile (default mixed feed), answers, questions, posts, followers, following (Spaces the user follows), or log.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Quora username, i.e. the last path segment of https://www.quora.com/profile/<name>. Example: Hector-Quintanilla.

parameters.name: section
parameters.description: Which profile tab to return: profile (default recent-activity feed with metadata) | answers | questions | posts (Space-hosted posts) | followers | following (Spaces the user follows) | log (public edit history).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum entries for list-like sections (1-100, default 20). Ignored when section=profile.
